The '''Knurled Highlands''' was a region of [[Iope]],<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]],<ref name="Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref> that featured a high density of [[Berry/Legends|berry]] [[Bush/Legends|shrubs]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the shrubs' existence was the only remaining indicator that the Highlands had at one point supported settlements.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Iopean Harvest" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must take place around that year as well.</ref> an individual affiliated with one of the two warring sides sent a companion of theirs to investigate the possibility of other evidence pointing to settlement in the Knurled Highlands.<ref name="TOR" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Knurled Highlands were mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Iopean Harvest," released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
